Prevention: Early planting and harvesting, e.g. plant in
August (2nd planting) and harvest after three months for improved varieties e.g.
Use clean and unaffected vines preferably obtained from the middle to the top of the plant
Intercrop sweet potato with onion or
Silver leaf ( Desmodium sp. ), if available
Earthen the soil to prevent egg laying and larval movement
Destroy caterpillar infested weeds around plots
Monitoring: Sweet potato butterflies, especially in the dry season
Look for caterpillars feeding on leaves
Check for young caterpillars by looking underneath the leaves
Direct Control: Use sweep nets to capture adult butterflies
With hand gloves, collect larvae and destroy by crushing them outside the field
Prune older leaves to allow enough sun light to discourage egg laying and if eggs already laid, the excessive heat of the sun will destroy them
Restrictions: Use less hazardous insecticide e.g. chlorpyrifos (70 ml in 5 lit of water and spray witha knapsack sprayers)
